title: Vintage camera 3D model
description: A high-detail 3D model of a classic rangefinder camera with a leather strap and worn trim (27K triangles). For a retro look and for framing a product intro
when_to_use: Scenes that need a precise prop model that live action is unlikely to supply, such as a retro or analog product intro, a hero shot about photo or video gear, or a still-life opening
ai_usage: 取得後に fragment 化する際は、ポーズ（回転角）と配置・拡大率のみ変数化してよい。素材固有のジオメトリ・ベイク済みテクスチャ（革の質感・傷等）は改変しない。カメラボディの色は焼き込みテクスチャのため knob 化しない

provenance.origin: AKARI Video 素材カタログ収録（Poly Haven）/ 2026-07-14

author: Rajil Jose Macatangay (Poly Haven)
